characterList.description: A young woman with long blonde hair, wearing a gray cropped T-shirt and denim shorts. She gives the room tour and appears to be the most organized of the group.
characterList.name: Katie

characterList.description: A young man with short brown hair, wearing a dark blue polo shirt and khaki shorts. He is moving into the dorm room and receives the tour from Katie.
characterList.name: Brennan

characterList.description: A young man with curly brown hair, wearing a white jacket with a hood and a black backpack. He helps with the tour and seems less attentive than Katie and Brennan.
characterList.name: Ryan

characterList.description: The roommate, only seen briefly in the reflection of the bathroom mirror.  He has short brown hair and wears a gray T-shirt.
characterList.name: Derek
